title: UPI callbacks delayed from partner bank
alert: upi-switch callback latency p99 8.2s for Kotak, pending transactions growing
root cause: Kotak was degraded on the payment switch and our retries doubled the load on it
fix: Enabled the bank-level circuit breaker for Kotak and showed a "bank is slow" banner in the app

title: UPI collect requests timing out
alert: payments-api p99 8.2s during a cashback campaign, Hikari waiting threads above 150
root cause: A long finance report query held connections on the primary during a cashback campaign, exhausting the pool
fix: Moved the finance report to the read replica and killed the long-running sessions

title: Wallet top-ups failing
alert: Lock wait timeout exceeded on ledger_entries; wallet top-ups failing
root cause: The month-end reconciliation job ran on the primary database and locked ledger_entries
fix: Killed the reconciliation job and moved it to the read replica

title: eKYC verification timing out
alert: kyc-service vendor timeouts at 35%; customer vikram.t@outlook.com stuck at onboarding
root cause: The eKYC vendor lowered our rate limit and requests above it hung until timeout
failed fixes: Increasing the vendor timeout to 60 seconds
fix: Added a token-bucket queue at the new vendor limit and retried queued verifications

title: Customers charged twice

failed fixes: Issuing manual refunds one by one
fix: Added an idempotency key on transaction id and auto-reversed the duplicate charges
